stale_rule: stale = age_days > stale_threshold_days, where the threshold is 2 x the update frequency: daily 2, business-day series 4 (covers a weekend), weekly 14, monthly 62, monthly_lagged 92 (monthly statistics published with a lag of about 6-7 weeks, e.g. Eurostat STS; added 2026-09-04), quarterly 184 (added 2026-09-04); annual and irregular series are not judged (v1.0 initial values, docs/指標定義_サイト生存状態_health.md). source_review = under_review when the last 3 or more fetch attempts failed in a row (consecutive_fetch_failures; v1.2, 2026-09-05): the series is shown as observing (source under review), its last confirmed value is kept and not judged until the source is confirmed.
site_status_rule: ok = no stale series and no failed last fetch among judged series; degraded otherwise. Series without a stale judgement (annual/irregular such as manually updated ones), not-yet-measured series and not-connected sources never make the site degraded (their status is still shown).

definition.doc: docs/指標定義_サイト生存状態_health.md

_note: AI Lifeline - liveness of the whitepaper itself (added 2026-09-03). For every published series in every edition: last confirmed observation date, update frequency, next expected update, stale (past the expected date by more than the threshold), and the status of the last fetch. Regenerated after each edition daily batch; on failure the previous file is kept. Nothing here judges the observed world - only whether this site is keeping up.

thresholds.transfer_failure: any failed or partial transfer since the last successful one raises the alert (independent counter, fires on the first failure)
thresholds.basis: live_age_days = (value date on the local site\ summary.json) - (value date on the live summary.json). Value date, not generation time. Fixed by the owner on 2026-09-12.

publish.ledger: data/state/publish_state.json (internal). One row per transfer (jp/us/eu; scope; files ok/failed; curl exit codes; source IP; log), days finished without publishing, and a live observation. Added 2026-09-12.
publish.rule: All three editions publish from their daily batch (Japan edition switched from manual to automatic on 2026-09-12; a publish lock file pauses the Japan batch when present). live_age_days = (value date on the locally generated summary.json) - (value date on the live summary.json), judged by the value date and not by the generation time: 2 days = caution, 3 = warning, 5 = action (fixed 2026-09-12). transfer_failures_since_last_success is an independent counter that alerts on the first failure. Skipped days are shown but do not alert. This block does not change site_status.
